title: Calibrated flow cytometry enables rapid detection of CD45EpCAMextracellular vesicles for pancreatic cancer clinical assessment.
snippet: Reliable non-invasive biomarkers are needed to optimize treatment selection and enable real-time monitoring of pancreatic cancer (PC). title: Long non-coding RNA prompts immune-related adverse events risk and immunotherapy response in pan-cancer.
snippet: Immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) improve cancer outcomes but can cause immune-related adverse events (irAEs) that compromise treatment. Using FAERS real-world data, we developed a two-layer network algorithm to identify irAE-associated lncRNAs (irAEsLncs) across 18 cancer types.
